server.description: The commissioning chain as the control post plays it, with the commander at every decision: a device registers, the procedure factory writes the test, Mother relays it, the commander authorises on the page, the executor runs it on the stand-in world, the Observer formulates the twin, the graph factory builds it or declares a node missing with its contract, the commander answers the hand-off's questions, the code factory writes the node, the request is replayed, the twin is proposed
server.instructions: start plays a run (world lab or hidden-occupant; leak true for the hand-off and its questions; builder reasoner or scripted, the latter with the request the Observer would write). The run waits for the commander twice: station.commissioning_authorise on the page's buttons, and station.answer in the questions panel. commissioning://run says where it stands, loop by loop, with the nature of who acts (code, a model, the script, the human) and the tasks opened.

start.title: Play a commissioning
start.description: Start the chain: registration, the procedure factory, Mother's relay, the commander's authorisation (waited for), the execution on the stand-in world, the report, the Observer, the graph factory, the hand-off with the commander's questions (waited for) when a node is missing, the proposal. One run at a time.

state.title: Where the run stands
state.description: The current run, loop by loop (who, of what nature, status, what it waits for, the task opened), and the runs before it.

reset.title: Drop the record
reset.description: Forget the current run's record on this slot; a run still playing goes on. The station keeps its own record.

commissioning://run.description: The current run: its options, its commissioning, its loops with their nature, status and what they wait for, the tasks opened, how it ended.
